Bettina, for the tracker: the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **3 November 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest of 2 November says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your cutover recap from 8 December 2025 gives the same official date.

Your recap also says you kept running the account day to day until 21 November, and that Kwame fully took over on **22 November 2025**. If the tracker needs a single date, use 3 November for the official change and note 22 November as when Kwame took over day to day.
